scope: Post hoc supplementary sensitivity analysis after observing ten automatic-estimator failures; retain original confirmatory results unchanged.
rate_justification: Known per-base substitution probability from the existing simulator, selected without optimizing Shepherd accuracy. Gives Shepherd the generating substitution rate; does not supply truth identities, counts or repeat-specific indel rates. Other methods retain their frozen settings.
milo_rate: Original automatic estimation; no new error-rate assumption for the archived fixed reference.
threshold_justification: Author-documented default. The original frozen benchmark explicitly used +4; preserve and disclose it rather than silently relabel it as default.
distance_justification: Retain the original explicit distance limit, matching the benchmark's other configurations. This is not an all-default Shepherd configuration.
cells: All 120 registered final simulated inputs plus fixed Milo, one call each in original dataset order; no outcome-based exclusions or parameter selection.
other_methods: Reuse all frozen outputs and accepted timing observations. No Barbac code, simulator, truth, seeds or competitor binaries changed.
timing: Fresh Python worker, Shepherd startup and execution, canonical exports; excludes common staging and scoring. Serial runs; keep-awake assertion; later-session times must be labelled as such.
failures: Retain every failure; no unregistered retry or success-only full-design inference.
analysis: Report complete per-design means, FN, FP, read accuracy and median time. Supplementary paired LV-minus-Shepherd F1 differences with Bonferroni one-sided alpha 0.05/8 t and 100000-resample bootstrap lower bounds (seeds 2026091301 and 2026091302). Conservative reference to the original eight-comparison family; post hoc configuration choice precludes retroactive confirmatory status.
barbac_development: Consumed final test seeds are not available for algorithm tuning. Diagnose recall only on existing development inputs and genuine-neighbour controls.
